name: growisto-claude-telemetry
description: Records Claude Code usage (prompt preview, skill, folder, session) and reports it to Growisto analytics. Never records full prompts, responses, or file contents.

ga4MeasurementId.title: GA4 measurement ID
ga4MeasurementId.description: The G- ID of the Growisto analytics property. Ask Neel if you do not have it.

ga4ApiSecret.title: GA4 API secret
ga4ApiSecret.description: Write credential for the analytics property. Stored by Claude Code, not written to disk in plain text.

userEmail.title: Work email
userEmail.description: Leave blank to use your git config user.email. Set it if your git identity is a personal address.

team.title: Team
team.description: Optional. Used to group usage by team in dashboards.

promptCapture.title: Prompt capture mode
promptCapture.description: preview keeps the first 100 characters of each prompt. hash keeps only a one-way hash and no readable text.

pathCapture.title: Folder capture mode
pathCapture.description: full records the working directory path, basename records only the folder name, none records no location at all.
